title: Instruction Generation & Optimization
summary: This module provides tools and signatures for generating, optimizing, and refining instructions for language models. It covers basic instruction proposals, feedback-driven multimodal instruction generation, and program-grounded instruction creation for specific modules.

nodes.label: Refine Instruction with Feedback
nodes.title: Feedback-Based Instruction Refinement
nodes.description: Generates a new instruction for a group to improve task performance based on previous instructions and specific feedback, especially for effective tool usage.

nodes.label: Propose Initial Instruction
nodes.title: Basic Instruction Generation
nodes.description: Optimizes instructions for language models by proposing an initial instruction and a prefix for the output field based on a given signature.

nodes.label: Improve Instruction from Attempts
nodes.title: Instruction Improvement from Attempts
nodes.description: Proposes an improved instruction for a language model given a history of attempted instructions and their validation scores, aiming for better performance.

nodes.label: Propose Multimodal Instructions
nodes.title: Multimodal Instruction Proposer
nodes.description: Handles GEPA-compatible multimodal instruction proposals by iterating through components and using a single-component proposer for updates.

nodes.label: Enhance Multimodal Instruction
nodes.title: Enhanced Multimodal Instruction from Feedback
nodes.description: Creates a better instruction for an assistant performing multimodal tasks, addressing visual analysis issues and integrating visual and textual information based on feedback.

nodes.label: Induce Natural Language Rules
nodes.title: Custom Rules Induction
nodes.description: Extracts concise and non-redundant natural language rules from a set of examples to provide clear guidance for performing a task.

nodes.label: Describe Program Task
nodes.title: Program Task Description
nodes.description: Analyzes pseudocode and an example of a language model program to describe its intended task and how it operates.

nodes.label: Describe Module Role
nodes.title: Module Role Description
nodes.description: Explains the purpose of a specific module within a larger language model program, given the program's code, example, and overall description.

nodes.label: Generate Module Instruction
nodes.title: Single Module Instruction Generation
nodes.description: Generates a new instruction for a specific language model module, leveraging program context, dataset summaries, and previous instruction attempts.

groups.label: General Instruction Optimization
groups.title: General Instruction Optimization
groups.description: Focuses on improving or generating general instructions for language models, often iteratively or based on feedback.

groups.label: Multimodal Instruction Generation
groups.title: Multimodal Instruction Generation
groups.description: Specializes in creating and refining instructions for tasks involving multimodal inputs, particularly visual and textual data.

groups.label: Program-Grounded Instruction Generation
groups.title: Program-Grounded Instruction Generation
groups.description: Generates instructions for specific modules within a larger program by first understanding the program's overall structure and individual module roles.

groups.label: Rule Induction
groups.title: Rule Induction
groups.description: Derives actionable natural language rules from provided examples to guide task execution.
